etf_momentum.description: Every month picks the topN ETFs with the strongest momentum among those above MA200 with moderate volatility and drawdown; in a weak market invests only part of the contribution.
etf_momentum.report.rebalance.name: Rebalance
etf_momentum.report.rebalance.descriptio: The contribution, buys and sells as the strategy decides.
etf_momentum.report.risk_review.name: Risk review
etf_momentum.report.risk_review.descript: Stop-losses and exit signals between rebalances; sells only on a signal.
etf_momentum.rationale.title: Why these ETFs
etf_momentum.column.momentum_hint: Return over {months} mo: ETFs are ranked by it.
etf_momentum.param.top_n: How many ETFs to hold; each gets 1/topN of the portfolio.
etf_momentum.param.ma_period: Moving average for the trend filter.
etf_momentum.param.max_drawdown: Deepest allowed drawdown over a year.
etf_momentum.param.max_vix: VIX above which the market counts as weak.
etf_momentum.param.min_momentum: Absolute momentum that must be exceeded.
etf_momentum.param.hold_buffer_k: A held position stays while its rank is no worse than this number.
etf_momentum.param.max_per_group: How many ETFs may be taken from one group.
etf_momentum.param.max_correlation: Highest correlation with an ETF already chosen over the last half year; 1 turns the check off.
etf_momentum.param.sell_on_position_exit: Sell a single position on its own exit rule. When off, it only warns, and the exit of the whole portfolio still applies.
etf_momentum.param.risk_free_rate: Risk-free rate when the cash ETF has too little history.
etf_momentum.param.max_stale_days: How many days a price may go without an update.
etf_momentum.param.stop_loss_pct: Stop-loss from the entry price (scaled by volatility).
etf_momentum.param.ma_exit_band: Sell only below MA200 minus this share.
etf_momentum.param.weak_market_invest_pc: Share of the contribution invested when the market is weak.
etf_momentum.market.spy_above: SPY {price} is above its 200-day average ({average}): the broad market is in an uptrend.
etf_momentum.market.spy_below: SPY {price} is below its 200-day average ({average}): the broad market is weak.
etf_momentum.market.spy_missing: No fresh SPY data: the trend cannot be checked, so the market counts as weak.
etf_momentum.market.vix_missing: No fresh VIX data: the stress level cannot be checked, so the market counts as weak.
etf_momentum.market.vix_calm: VIX {vix} is below the threshold of {limit}: no panic in the market.
etf_momentum.market.vix_stress: VIX {vix} is at or above the threshold of {limit}: the market is under stress.
etf_momentum.scan.stronger_exist: passes the filters, but stronger ones exist (rank {rank})
etf_momentum.scan.held_in_buffer: already held, rank {rank} within the buffer of {buffer}
etf_momentum.risk.spy_missing: No fresh SPY data: the market trend cannot be checked.
etf_momentum.risk.spy_below: SPY is below its 200-day average ({price} vs {average}): the market is weak. The next monthly plan invests only part of the contribution; nothing is sold by force.
etf_momentum.risk.vix_missing: No fresh VIX data: check the market's stress level by hand.
etf_momentum.risk.vix_exit: VIX {vix} is above {limit}: high stress. Positions with warnings are sold right now.
etf_momentum.risk.vix_warn: VIX {vix} is above {limit}: volatility is elevated, be careful.
etf_momentum.risk.action_sell: Sell all of {ticker} (≈ {value}) and move the money to {parking}. Reason: {reason}
etf_momentum.risk.action_watch: Sell nothing. Watch {ticker}: exit if the closing price falls below {price}.
etf_momentum.risk.portfolio_exit: The portfolio is {drawdown} below its peak: the limit of {limit} is reached.
etf_momentum.risk.action_sell_all: Sell every position and move the money to {parking}. Return to the market with the next monthly plan.
etf_momentum.risk.portfolio_warn: The portfolio is {drawdown} below its peak (warning at {warn}, exit at {limit}).
etf_momentum.risk.stale: last price from {date}, the data is stale.
etf_momentum.risk.alert_stop: {ticker}: the stop-loss fired ({pnl} with a limit of {limit}).
etf_momentum.risk.alert_ma: {ticker}: the price is more than {band} below MA200 ({average}).
etf_momentum.risk.alert_trail: {ticker}: drawdown from the high {drawdown} with a limit of {limit}.
etf_momentum.risk.alert_below_ma: {ticker}: the price is below MA200, but within the tolerance of {band}.
etf_momentum.risk.alert_loss: {ticker}: loss of {pnl} from the entry price.
etf_momentum.plan.no_price: No price for {ticker}: check this position by hand.
etf_momentum.plan.trim: weight {weight} is above the target of {target} by more than {band}: sell the excess
etf_momentum.plan.unpark: parked money goes back to work
etf_momentum.plan.park: parking: money not invested this month
etf_momentum.plan.exit_not_listed: not on the strategy's ETF list
etf_momentum.plan.buy_more: top up to the target of {weight} of the portfolio ({detail})
etf_momentum.plan.buy_new: new position, target {weight} of the portfolio ({detail})
etf_momentum.plan.zero_contribution: This month's contribution is 0. Set monthly_contribution in the config or pass --contribution.
etf_momentum.plan.weak_market: The market is weak: investing {share} of the contribution ({invested}), parking the rest ({rest}) in {parking}.
etf_momentum.plan.parked_waits: The market is weak: parked money ({parked}) stays in {parking} until the market recovers.
etf_momentum.plan.market_recovered: The market is fine: parked money ({parked}) goes back to work.
etf_momentum.plan.nothing_picked: No ETF passed the filters: all the money stays in {parking}.
etf_momentum.plan.partial_targets: The strategy's targets take {total} of the portfolio: the rest stays in {parking}.
etf_momentum.plan.buys_below_one_share: Not enough for one share, so not buying: {tickers:join:, }. The money stays in {parking}.
etf_momentum.plan.trims_skipped_at_loss: Above target but at a loss now, so not selling: {tickers:join:, }. Buys of other positions level the weight.
etf_momentum.cli.update_positions: After the trades, update positions.json with the actual execution prices.
etf_momentum.cli.details_link: Details and explanations: the HTML report in GitHub Actions.
etf_momentum.cli.market_ok: The market is fine: investing the whole contribution ({invested}).
etf_momentum.cli.market_weak: The market is weak: investing {share} of the contribution ({invested}), parking the rest.
etf_momentum.cli.backtest_contribution: Contribution of {amount} every month, compared with {benchmark} (the same contributions).
etf_momentum.cli.backtest_comparisons: Simple portfolios (return per year, Sharpe, drawdown):
etf_momentum.cli.backtest_trades: Trades: {trades}, trading costs: {costs}, risk monitor sales: {exits}.
etf_momentum.cli.backtest_months: Months with a fine market: {ok} of {months}.
etf_momentum.cli.backtest_footnote: * incomplete year. The ETF list is today's, taxes are not counted.
etf_momentum.cli.risk.verdict_ok: No action needed. Every position is within the rules.
etf_momentum.cli.risk.verdict_watch: Nothing needs selling, but there are warnings.
etf_momentum.cli.risk.verdict_act: Action needed: follow the steps below.
etf_momentum.cli.risk.title: Weekly risk review | data as of {date}
